|---|---|

| Diagnosis | Both paths delete the central `<PackageVersion>` with no consumer check. ### 11. change-signature-callsite-rewrites-enclosing-invocation

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | direct |
| Diagnosis | `ChangeSignatureAddRemovePreviewBuilder.cs:134` `oldRoot.FindNode(span).FirstAncestorOrSelf<InvocationExpressionSyntax>()` runs for every caller location from `SymbolFinder.FindCallersAsync`; a non-invocation reference (method group `list.Select(svc.Compute)`, `nameof(svc.Compute)`) climbs to the nearest enclosing invocation (`Select`/`nameof`) and rewrites that call's argument list, counting it in `callsiteUpdates`. |
| Approach | Accept the ancestor invocation only when the reference is the invoked expression: `invocation.Expression.FullSpan.Contains(span)` (covers `Compute(..)`, `a.Compute(..)`, `a.Compute<T>(..)`); otherwise skip. Method-group and `nameof` references fall outside `Expression` and are left untouched, and the skipped spans are not counted in `callsiteCount`. |

Existing op=add/remove tests must stay green. |
